messages:
sophie: FYI - FinRegCo RFP: POC must keep processing and storage inside EU, failover allowed to a single secondary EU region, customer insists on BYOK (GCP KMS) even for trial, and they want the full sub-processor list + certs before signing. They asked for a "fast" Hosted-style POC if we can meet constraints. Need a short options list, technical blockers, and a pricing sketch for the deal team. who can help?
rahul: Quick clarifying q: by BYOK do they mean all data keys (model payloads/artefacts) AND telemetry/logs, or just encryption-at-rest for stored artifacts? That affects scope.
sophie: they want BYOK for all persisted customer data for the POC (artifacts + logs). telemetry is a second-tier ask but mentioned explicitly. They also want no egress outside EU for any data path.
rahul: TL;DR from infra: Hosted cannot be configured to use customer-managed KMS. Hosted encrypts at rest with our keys; we can restrict compute to EU regions by routing, but KMS calls will be to our cloud project. BYOK is supported on Dedicated or Private.
rahul: Options we can offer (short):
- Hosted EU pin (fast): route requests to eu-west1 primary, eu-west2 failover; no BYOK; provide subproc attestation + SOC2/ISO certs.
- Short-lived Dedicated EU pool (fast-ish): spin a small Dedicated GPU pool in customer-preferred EU region, connect to customer GCP KMS (BYOK), supply subproc list. Faster than full Private but still requires infra provisioning and KMS IAM setup.
- Private (VPC or on-prem): full BYOK + strict no-egress, longest lead time.
rahul: also possible hybrid: Dedicated workers in EU for inference + Hosted control plane outside customer data path for orchestration. Compliance treats that as Dedicated for BYOK.
claire: Compliance notes: we can deliver a sub-processor attestation listing our vendor partners. Current sub-processors for EU-hosted infra: GCP (europe regions), Grafana Cloud (metrics ingestion - EU tenancy where available), Honeycomb (has EU data processing options), Sentry (EU orgs), and external CDNs for static assets. We can attach SOC2 + ISO27001 cert copies. However: we cannot remove the cloud provider from Hosted. Some observability vendors have EU-only options but we must validate per vendor.
claire: if customer requires all third parties to be EU-only with certs on file, Dedicated/Private is the safer path. For Hosted we can provide attestation but there will be vendor exceptions to call out.
ops: Pricing sketch for the POC (ballpark, to use in the deck):
- Hosted EU-pin POC: no infra uplift, just usage. Offer 2 weeks of usage credits (negotiable). Estimated incremental cost to us: minimal.
- Dedicated short-lived POC (2 weeks): one small GPU pool (2x A10q or equivalent), provisioning fee: 4, reserved prorated cost: 3 - 4 (depending on GPU type) for 2 weeks, BYOK/KMS integration setup fee: 3 - 4. Example conservative total: 9-? wait placeholder hmm
